snowyspirit.configuration.snow_season_st: Month from which villagers will start placing wreaths, presents and throwing snowballs
Day from which villagers will start placing wreaths, presents and throwing snowballs
snowyspirit.configuration.snow_season_en: Month from which villagers will start removing placed wreaths
Day from which villagers will start removing placed wreaths
snowyspirit.configuration.season_mod_com: Enables compatibility with Serene Seasons (Forge) or Fabric Seasons (Fabric). Only takes effect if the mod is installed. Will make snowy season only active during certain seasons. Note that this will override previous time window settings
snowyspirit.configuration.misc.mod_creat: Gather all this mod items in their own creative tab instead of putting them in the vanilla ones
snowyspirit.configuration.blocks_and_ite: Only makes sense to turn off with both ginger and gumdrops off
snowyspirit.configuration.friction.sand_: Advanced setting. Controls how sleds slide along other blocks, in other words its the inverse of friction. This number affects how the sled speed is multiplied each tick. A value of 1 will make it keep its velocity forever. Increasing these values will effectively increase the sled top speed when on these blocks
snowyspirit.configuration.friction.ice_s: Used to decrease ice friction (for sleds)
snowyspirit.configuration.friction.slope: Factor that will be added to a block slipperiness when the sled is considered on a slope (angled down). This is also scaled by the slope angle, applying the full number at 45 degrees. This config alters how fast sleds go down slopes
snowyspirit.configuration.friction.rotat: Multiply angular velocity by this number each tick. Can be thought of as rotational drag
Same as above but applied when you are pressing W. Lower number makes it harder to steer when accelerating forward
snowyspirit.configuration.steering.forwa: Intensity of velocity increase applied when pressing forward. These forces are applied each tick when moving a sled so they also indirectly alter its max speed
Same as above but only when sled has a wolf
Forward Acceleration When Not On Snow
Acceleration when not on snow. Note that this is noticeably higher since its the higher frictions of those blocks that dont allow the sled to move fast
snowyspirit.configuration.steering.steer: Affects the intensity of side steering
Same as above but when a wolf is active
snowyspirit.configuration.sled.max_sled_: Max allowed size of a sled entity puller. Allowing bigger ones could cause issue as hitbox will clash with sled itself
snowyspirit.configuration.particles.glow: Glow light particle mode. I made 2 variants of this so choose the one you like the most
